subject: "MKL threads are not set as requested" - error in Windows

messages.author: 7ba90ca9d0486fc8
messages.subject: "MKL threads are not set as requested" - error in Windows
parts:
Hi all,
        I'm using MRO 3.2.3 on my Windows x64 machine with Intel i3 Processor. When ever I'm supplying the command setMKLthreads(4), it is showing the following,

MKL threads are not set as requested:
 2  instead of  4  threads are used.

Is there anything wrong ? How to use all the four cores in my machine with MRO ?

messages.author: 149440eddb848db9
messages.subject: Re: "MKL threads are not set as requested" - error in Windows
parts:
Your Intel I3 uses hyperthreading, so you only have 2 physical cores and 4 logical cores.

The Intel MKL can only utilise physical cores.

We have answered similar threads with more detail.  See, for example:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/rropen/MKL$20cores/rropen/ecKiHf6H-_g/LjgrEDvCfA8J
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/rropen/MKL$20cores/rropen/LixUgKR8_Ko/dEHu_OtaAwAJ

I hope this helps

Andrie
